{{Quote|Detonating Ion bands. Listen to them pop!|Dalash Ard in her part in attacking the droid factory|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire" />}}
'''Dalash Ard''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior who lived during the [[war against Zakuul]]. During the Mandalorian raid on [[Zakuul]] droid factory, Dalash was one of the team leaders who assisted [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] during the attack, helping destroy many [[Skytrooper]]s.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dalash Ard first appeared in the 14th chapter of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' Mandalore's Revenge.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire" />
